title: Allowance Year Calendar and New-Hire Proration Rates (SafeStep)
content:
# Allowance Calendar — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

Allowances and pair counts in the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program run over an allowance year. The year basis, the grant date, the share of unused allowance carried forward, the waiting period before a newly hired employee may be added and the share of each annual allowance granted to a participant added during the year all vary by tier.

## Calendar by tier

| Tier | Year over which allowances and pair counts run | When the annual allowance is granted | Unused allowance carried into the next allowance year |
|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | Calendar year | First day of the allowance year | 0 percent |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | Calendar year | First day of the allowance year | 0 percent |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | Calendar year | First day of the allowance year | 0 percent |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | Program anniversary year | First day of the allowance year | 0 percent |
| SafeStep Premier | Program anniversary year | First day of the allowance year | 25 percent |
| SafeStep Enterprise | Program anniversary year | First day of the allowance year | 50 percent |

## New-hire waiting period and proration

| Tier | Calendar days after the hire date before the employee may be added | Share of the annual allowance for a participant added in quarter 1 | Quarter 2 | Quarter 3 | Quarter 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 90 | 100 percent | 75 percent | 50 percent | 25 percent |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 90 | 100 percent | 75 percent | 50 percent | 25 percent |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 60 | 100 percent | 75 percent | 50 percent | 25 percent |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 60 | 100 percent | 100 percent | 75 percent | 50 percent |
| SafeStep Premier | 30 | 100 percent | 100 percent | 75 percent | 50 percent |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 0 | 100 percent | 100 percent | 100 percent | 75 percent |

Quarters are the quarters of the allowance year, numbered 1 to 4 from the start of that year.

## Notes to the calendar

- On a calendar-year tier the allowance year is the calendar year; on a program-anniversary tier it runs from the program's go-live anniversary.
- On every tier the annual allowance is granted on the first day of the allowance year.
- A carry-forward of 0 percent means that no unused allowance passes into the next allowance year.
- SafeStep Enterprise has no waiting period: its figure is 0 calendar days.

## Reading the proration columns

**On SafeStep Premier, what share of each annual allowance does a participant added in the second quarter receive?** 100 percent.

**On SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear, a participant added in the fourth quarter?** 25 percent.

**Which tier grants a full annual allowance to a participant added in the third quarter?** SafeStep Enterprise only.
